Talata 1000

Own a piece of the story

We are looking for 1.000 partners. Every partner gets a number, #0001 to #1000, and a real say in how the club grows. From 300 kr a season.

Become a partnerSee the tiers

The story so far

20players in August 2024
110+players today
6teams in DBBF leagues
2players gone on to North America

August 2024. One team, twenty kids, our first DBBF season. Today we have 110+ players, from five-year-olds on a Saturday morning to our men’s team, and six teams in DBBF leagues.

Malthe went to Orangeville Prep in Ontario in 2025. Johan, one of the first twenty, plays high school basketball in Ohio this season. The next ones are in the gym right now.

Pick your tier

Every tier runs for one season. Every partner gets a number.

Supporter

300 kr / season

For anyone. Grandparents, alumni, neighbours, friends of the club.

  • Your partner number
  • Your name on the partner wall
  • Everything in What owners get

Founding Partner

1.000 kr / season

For people who want to back the club in a bigger way.

  • A Talata cap or socks
  • A reserved seat at a home game
  • 10% off camps for a child or grandchild
  • Everything in Supporter

Court Partner

5.000 kr / season

For local shops, clinics and cafés near our halls.

  • Your logo on the courtside banner at home games
  • Your name read out at home games
  • Your logo on the partners page and one Instagram post
  • Your name on the training tops
  • Window sticker and Morning Coffee

Team Partner

15.000 kr / season

Name one team for a whole season.

  • “Presented by” on that team’s game posters
  • Your logo on that team’s warm-ups
  • A signed, framed team jersey
  • Two posts on our Instagram and a team photo you can use
  • Everything in Court Partner

Travel Partner

40.000 kr / season

Backs our international tournament fund.

  • The fund carries your name
  • A basketball session for your staff, run by our head coach
  • Your logo on the travel kit
  • Trip photos for your own channels
  • Everything in Team Partner

Main Partner

75.000 kr / season

The club’s lead partner for the season.

  • Your name on one of our holiday camps
  • 4 free camp places to give away
  • Two staff basketball sessions a year
  • Named on every fixture and on the homepage
  • Everything in Travel Partner

The first 100 partners keep their price for life. Numbers #0001 to #0100.

What owners get

Every partner, from 300 kr up.

The Owners’ Letter

Once a year. Our players and teams, where every krone went, the wins and what comes next.

Partner night

A game and a short meeting, once a year. Partners vote on one real thing, like the next warm-up design or where we run a free clinic.

Your name on the wall

On this page and on the banner in our gym.

Early camp access

Camp places open to partners first.

A quarterly update

Four short notes a year from the club.

For businesses

A window sticker for your shop, “Vi støtter Talata Basketball”, and the yearly Talata Morning Coffee with the other partners.

Talata 1000 is a supporter membership. Every krone stays in the club. The vote at partner night is advisory.

How to join

  1. Pick your tier

    Supporter or Founding Partner for people. Court Partner and up for businesses.

  2. Pay

    MobilePay 52697, or bank transfer to the account at the bottom of this page. Write “Talata 1000” and your name.

  3. Send us your name

    Email us the name for the wall. We send your partner number back. Businesses, email us and we send an invoice.
